400 Bad Request error on stream due to content policy violation

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest
from liter_llm import ContentPolicyError, Error

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Generate harmful content\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4o\",\"stream\":true}")
        result = client.chat_stream(request)
        chunks = []
        async for chunk in result:
            chunks.append(chunk)
    except ContentPolicyError as error:
        print(f"ContentPolicyError: {error}")
    except Error as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
